entities.name: DL message segment transfer
entities.description: Procedure to transfer segments of DL DCCH messages from the network to the UE. Segmentation is only applicable to RRCReconfiguration and RRCResume messages in this release.

entities.name: DLDedicatedMessageSegment
entities.description: Message used to transfer segments of DL DCCH messages from network to UE.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration
entities.description: DL DCCH message that can be segmented using the DLDedicatedMessageSegment procedure.

entities.name: RRCResume
entities.description: DL DCCH message that can be segmented using the DLDedicatedMessageSegment procedure.

entities.name: Segmentation applicable condition
entities.description: Condition that segmentation is only applicable to RRCReconfiguration and RRCResume messages in this release.

relations.description: The DL message segment transfer procedure uses the DLDedicatedMessageSegment message.
The procedure is guarded by the condition that segmentation only applies to specific message types.
The condition establishes that RRCReconfiguration messages can be segmented.
The condition establishes that RRCResume messages can be segmented.
